[C] FloatingBox variants
|-- FloatingBox = FloatingPane | FloatingBoxArrow
|-- DisplayNodeBase
|   |-- id, childIds, expansion, expandedGeometry
|   |-- CSS pixel position/bounds; canvas | viewport
|   `-- geometryPolicy: automatic/manual; content/fixed
|-- FloatingPane union stored in DisplayState.nodes
|   |-- selection: SelectionRegion
|   |   |-- captured source box/content/revision/ASCII
|   |   `-- rect, selectedIds, displayMode, activeChildId
|   |-- projection: ProjectedPane
|   |   |-- title, projection/revision IDs, activeChildId
|   |   `-- content: call-tree | compaction
|   |       `-- or source-code | code-panel (saved scroll)
|   |-- conversation: ConversationPane
|   |   `-- thread, draft, canvasAnchor, presentation
|   `-- detail: DetailPane -> title, ascii, sectionId?
|-- DisplayState manages pane parent/child membership
|   |-- addDisplayNode -> attach to owner or roots
|   |-- removeDisplayNode -> remove subtree; repair links
|   `-- setExpansion saves/restores expanded geometry
|-- SelectionState alone owns selection membership
|-- SourcePaneViewState owns live scroll; panes save it
|-- Automatic placement needs region/parent/anchor data
|   `-- canvasDisplayNodes exposes placement + geometry
`-- Arrow is derived by drawEdge
    |-- needs edges, scene, views, cell, endpoint bounds
    `-- controller edits document.edges; no pane copy
